entries.subject: JWST observations of 2005RN43 (programme 2418)
entries.finding: JWST observed 2005RN43 in programme 2418 (NIRSpec IFU), a reflectance spectrum. The body is far smaller than JWST's resolution at its distance, so these give composition, not a resolved disc, shape or map. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
